name: Interior-Emphasized Transfer Function Style
aliases: Frequency-based Transfer Function for Interior-Emphasized Style
definition: A transfer function style that visualizes internal organs (bones, muscles, tendons, ligaments) with high opacity and contrasting colors, while visualizing fat as a semi-transparent membrane.
summary: This style visualizes internal organs with high opacity while rendering subcutaneous fat semi-transparent using a frequency-based histogram to prevent occlusion.
